na03f8585b1.headline: ECB could start rate cuts in June, De Cos says - Times of India
na03f8585b1.summary: ECB policymaker Pablo Hernandez de Cos said the European Central Bank could start cutting interest rates in June, after euro zone inflation fell. The statement was reported from Madrid.
na03f8585b1.why: The European Central Bank sets interest rates for the euro area, which shape euro yields, the currency and equity valuations across Europe.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Expectations of earlier ECB rate cuts typically weigh on the euro against other major currencies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

na03f8585b1.why_moved: Comments that rate cuts could start in June follow a drop in euro zone inflation, which shifts expectations for ECB policy.
